channel.title: Kevin Nie — Writing
channel.description: Notes on making LLM output reliable: validation pipelines, grounding, repair loops, and the bugs that hide behind them.

item.title: Knowing what the button is called
item.description: Turning QA test cases into scripts a real phone will run. Why the hard part was never the code, how mining the game source beat scanning the device, and what a false pass looks like.

item.title: Vibes with extra steps
item.description: Making "is this AI-generated card balanced?" a question with a measurable answer, by calibrating a power budget against real Slay the Spire cards.

item.title: Four views of one object
item.description: A multi-agent loop that turns one reference image into four consistent views. Why the judge is a separate agent, when to redo one view versus all four, and when to stop.
